test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Donna posted an article on health care.

options.text: An article on health care was posted by Donna.
An article on health care was been posted by Donna.
An article on health care is being posted by Donna.
An article on health care is posted by Donna.

solution:
Here the correct answer is **An article on health care was posted by Donna.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in** active voice.** We need to change it into **passive voice**.
 
• The sentence is in **simple past tense.**
 
• The **structure **of simple past tense is:
 
 
• Active Voice: Subject + V2 + Object.
 
• Passive Voice: Object + was/were + V3 + by + Subject.
 
 
 
• The subject **'Donna' **becomes the object of the passive voice.
 
• The object **'an article on health care'** becomes the subject of the passive voice.
 
• **'posted'** is changed to** 'was posted'.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

**Correct Passive Voice:**__ *An article on health care was posted by Donna.*
